title: Price icon lands inside the word after the BD-1192 fix
detail: With the Toybox skin on, the amber icon sits at x=687 inside "3,700 Crystals" (text at 652); offline checks passed, Studio shows the overlap.
fix: Icon and skin word label from one centred group; skin-on case in verify_price_group.py.

title: Empty nest slots show a full egg in a nest
detail: Each "Empty" slot uses the egg-in-nest picture, so it says empty but shows an egg.
fix: Empty slot = empty nest picture (or faded nest, no egg), egg art only when a nest holds an egg.

title: "AUTO: OFF" and "Auto-open: off" say the same thing twice
detail: The toggle shows its state and the line next to it repeats it.
fix: Keep the toggle; replace the line with what auto-open does ("Opens eggs for you").

title: Undiscovered dinos are hard black silhouettes
detail: Brief asked for soft tinted silhouettes; pure black on cream reads harsh and gloomy for kids.
fix: Silhouette in a soft tone of the card (e.g. 35% dark brown) with the rarity edge.

title: Fusion Menu still the old layout
detail: Text on studs (yellow "You need 6 Base..." and red "Hatch new dinos"), black slot boxes, five button colours.
fix: Put Fusion on the docs/232 rules like the detail page (cream panels, one primary button).

title: "BUILD" label alone under the eggs plate
detail: A lone "BUILD" word (no build id) shows under the eggs plate in Studio.
fix: Show the full build id or hide it outside Studio/admin.
